classes.label: Class diagram of the probe game
classes.description: Probe has a level and crystals and offers scanAll(rocks) and scanPower(). Asteroid has unscanned points, crystals, and tagged passes and offers scan(power), collectSample(), and tag(passes). SoundPlayer offers play(sound). StarMap records how many rocks it charts. Probe is associated with exactly one SoundPlayer through sfx and with zero or one StarMap through starMap, and depends on Asteroid for its rocks parameter.
classes.caption: The structure you already know: which classes exist, what each offers, and who can reach whom. It shows no order of calls.

trace.label: Sequence diagram of one run
trace.description: One run of the scan with the probe, the pebble, the boulder, and the sound player. A found message scanAll(rocks) reaches the probe. The probe sends play("ping") asynchronously to the sound player, then sends itself scanPower(). It calls scan(12) on the pebble, which replies 0, and collectSample() on the pebble, which replies 5. It calls scan(12) on the boulder, which replies 8, and then tag(2) on the boulder.
trace.caption: Read from top to bottom. A filled arrowhead means the sender waits; an open arrowhead means it continues; a dashed arrow is a reply.
trace.source:
@startuml
layout compact
participant probe: Probe
participant pebble: Asteroid
participant boulder: Asteroid
participant sfx: SoundPlayer
steps:
o-> probe: scanAll(rocks)
probe ->> sfx: play("ping")
probe -> probe: scanPower()
probe -> pebble: scan(12)
pebble --> probe: 0
probe -> pebble: collectSample()
pebble --> probe: 5
probe -> boulder: scan(12)
boulder --> probe: 8
probe -> boulder: tag(2)

trace_bars.label: The same run with activation bars
trace_bars.description: The run of the scan with activation bars. The probe is active from the arrival of scanAll(rocks) to its end, with a nested bar for the self-message scanPower(). The pebble is active while it handles scan(12) and collectSample(), and the boulder while it handles scan(12) and tag(2). The asynchronous play("ping") adds no bar.
trace_bars.caption: A bar runs from a call's arrival to its return, including time spent waiting for nested calls.
trace_bars.source:
@startuml
layout compact
participant probe: Probe
participant pebble: Asteroid
participant boulder: Asteroid
participant sfx: SoundPlayer
o-> probe: scanAll(rocks)
activate probe
probe ->> sfx: play("ping")
probe -> probe: scanPower()
activate probe
deactivate probe
probe -> pebble: scan(12)
activate pebble
pebble --> probe: 0
deactivate pebble
probe -> pebble: collectSample()
activate pebble
pebble --> probe: 5
deactivate pebble
probe -> boulder: scan(12)
activate boulder
boulder --> probe: 8
deactivate boulder
probe -> boulder: tag(2)
activate boulder
deactivate boulder
deactivate probe
@enduml

scan_loop.label: General diagram with a loop
scan_loop.description: The general scan diagram with the probe, one rock lifeline, and the sound player. After scanAll(rocks), play("ping"), and scanPower(), a loop fragment guarded by for each rock in rocks holds scan(power) from the probe to the rock and its reply, unscanned.
scan_loop.caption: One rock lifeline stands for whichever asteroid the loop reaches on each pass.
scan_loop.source:
@startuml
layout compact
participant probe: Probe
participant rock: Asteroid
participant sfx: SoundPlayer
o-> probe: scanAll(rocks)
activate probe
probe ->> sfx: play("ping")
probe -> probe: scanPower()
activate probe
deactivate probe
loop [for each rock in rocks]
probe -> rock: scan(power)
activate rock
rock --> probe: unscanned
deactivate rock
end
deactivate probe
@enduml

scan_alt.label: General diagram with a loop and an alt
scan_alt.description: Inside the loop for each rock in rocks, after scan(power) and its reply unscanned, an alt fragment has two operands. When unscanned == 0, the probe calls collectSample() on the rock and receives crystals. Otherwise, under the guard else, the probe calls tag(2) on the rock.
scan_alt.caption: A dashed line divides the alt frame into operands; at most one operand runs on each pass.
scan_alt.source:
@startuml
layout compact
participant probe: Probe
participant rock: Asteroid
participant sfx: SoundPlayer
o-> probe: scanAll(rocks)
activate probe
probe ->> sfx: play("ping")
probe -> probe: scanPower()
activate probe
deactivate probe
loop [for each rock in rocks]
probe -> rock: scan(power)
activate rock
rock --> probe: unscanned
deactivate rock
alt [unscanned == 0]
probe -> rock: collectSample()
activate rock
rock --> probe: crystals
deactivate rock
else [else]
probe -> rock: tag(2)
activate rock
deactivate rock
end
end
deactivate probe
@enduml

scan.label: Complete general diagram of the scan
scan.description: The complete general scan diagram. A found message scanAll(rocks) reaches the probe, which sends play("ping") asynchronously and scanPower() to itself. A loop for each rock in rocks holds scan(power) with its reply unscanned and an alt fragment: when unscanned == 0, collectSample() with reply crystals; otherwise tag(2). After the loop, an opt fragment guarded by every rock scanned creates starMap: StarMap and sends play("chime") asynchronously.
scan.caption: loop repeats, alt chooses at most one operand, and opt runs its operand or skips it.
scan.source:
@startuml
layout compact
participant probe: Probe
participant rock: Asteroid
participant sfx: SoundPlayer
participant starMap: StarMap
o-> probe: scanAll(rocks)
activate probe
probe ->> sfx: play("ping")
probe -> probe: scanPower()
activate probe
deactivate probe
loop [for each rock in rocks]
probe -> rock: scan(power)
activate rock
rock --> probe: unscanned
deactivate rock
alt [unscanned == 0]
probe -> rock: collectSample()
activate rock
rock --> probe: crystals
deactivate rock
else [else]
probe -> rock: tag(2)
activate rock
deactivate rock
end
end
opt [every rock scanned]
create starMap
probe --> starMap: <<create>>
activate starMap
deactivate starMap
probe ->> sfx: play("chime")
end
deactivate probe
@enduml

charted_run.label: One run with a pebble and a shard
charted_run.description: A concrete run with a pebble and a shard. After scanAll(rocks), play("ping"), and scanPower(), the probe calls scan(12) on the pebble, which replies 0, and collectSample(), which replies 5, then scan(12) on the shard, which replies 0, and collectSample(), which replies 2. Because every rock is scanned, the probe creates starMap: StarMap and sends play("chime") asynchronously. No tag message is sent.
charted_run.caption: This trace is one of the runs the general diagram describes: two passes through the loop, the first operand of the alt each time, and the opt.
charted_run.source:
@startuml
layout compact
participant probe: Probe
participant pebble: Asteroid
participant shard: Asteroid
participant sfx: SoundPlayer
participant starMap: StarMap
o-> probe: scanAll(rocks)
activate probe
probe ->> sfx: play("ping")
probe -> probe: scanPower()
activate probe
deactivate probe
probe -> pebble: scan(12)
activate pebble
pebble --> probe: 0
deactivate pebble
probe -> pebble: collectSample()
activate pebble
pebble --> probe: 5
deactivate pebble
probe -> shard: scan(12)
activate shard
shard --> probe: 0
deactivate shard
probe -> shard: collectSample()
activate shard
shard --> probe: 2
deactivate shard
create starMap
probe --> starMap: <<create>>
activate starMap
deactivate starMap
probe ->> sfx: play("chime")
deactivate probe
@enduml

recharge.label: Sequence diagram of the recharge
recharge.description: A found message rechargeAll(drones) reaches the dock. A loop fragment guarded by for each drone in drones holds lowBattery() from the dock to the drone with the reply low, and an opt fragment guarded by low around recharge(5). After the loop, the dock sends play("beep") asynchronously to the sound player.
recharge.caption: The answer to the exercise: the check is a synchronous call, the recharge is optional, and the beep is asynchronous.
recharge.source:
@startuml
layout compact
participant dock: Dock
participant drone: Drone
participant sfx: SoundPlayer
steps:
o-> dock: rechargeAll(drones)
activate dock
loop [for each drone in drones]
dock -> drone: lowBattery()
activate drone
drone --> dock: low
deactivate drone
opt [low]
dock -> drone: recharge(5)
activate drone
deactivate drone
end
end
dock ->> sfx: play("beep")
deactivate dock

stack.stack_note: The audio system plays the queued "ping" sound later, outside the probe's stack.

cards.title: Lifelines
cards.text: One per participant, headed name : Type. Time runs down the page; spacing is not a clock.

cards.title: Messages
cards.text: Filled arrowhead: the sender waits. Open arrowhead: it moves on. Dashed arrow: a reply. <<create>> starts a new lifeline.

cards.title: Activations
cards.text: A bar runs from a call's arrival to its return, including time spent waiting, like a stack frame.

cards.title: Fragments
cards.text: loop repeats as its guard allows, alt runs at most one guarded operand, and opt runs its operand or skips it.
